subject: test(material/autocomplete): typos and unresolved variables in tests (#29532)
reviewer: Codex primary implementer; independent audit remains separate

hunk_reviews.judgment: The auxilliary-to-auxiliary case-name correction is cosmetic. Keep the historical case name and its existing identity/order; renaming it would change the retained roster without repairing behavior.
The autocompete-to-autocomplete diagnostic spelling change affects assertion context only. Preserve the historical assertion and context; no product change follows.
The first Firefox, edge-to-Edge comment correction has no executable change. Preserve the historical comment and width assertion.
The second Firefox, edge-to-Edge comment correction likewise has no executable change. Preserve the separate historical width assertion and comment.

The first selector fix adds a missing closing bracket to a modern mat-option aria-selected query used by a minimal selection-indicator assertion. The exact malformed query and modern indicator case are absent from the complete owned legacy autocomplete spec. Do not transplant the modern option/indicator contract.

The second selector fix closes the corresponding query in the modern hidden-selection-indicator case. That private modern test is also absent; no existing legacy selector or assertion is deleted or broadened.

The first group template switches group.label to group.title. The untouched historical direct-group fixture uses *ngFor and group.label against three title data keys. Preserve the exact historical template; rename only those three private data keys to label, keeping One/Two/Three and all state arrays.

The second template changes the inherited indirect-group fixture in modern control-flow syntax. Its legacy counterpart inherits the same three objects and reads group.label. The same data repair supplies both bindings without changing either template, introducing modern control flow, or changing cases/assertions.

decision: Review all eight original autocomplete hunks individually. Keep historical case names, diagnostic text, comments and templates unchanged. The two malformed selectors belong to modern single-selection-indicator cases absent from the retained legacy suite. The two group binding hunks expose a real retained fixture defect: both legacy templates read group.label but the three shared stateGroups objects defined title, including in the untouched tagged reference. Adapt only the three private test-data keys from title to label. All template bytes, label values, state arrays, cases, assertions, imports, production resources and consumer structure/styles remain unchanged. Source and roster controls plus the83-scope/20-binding context requalification passed on this branch; actual artifact Angular execution remains required.
